parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: AddressPoolId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The new remarks for the address pool. If you leave this parameter empty, the remarks are deleted.
